requiredInput.story_prompt: Natural-language episode story or approved script

inheritedSettings.asset_canon: Episode01 original lead rigs, kitten, TownPopulation, EpisodeWorld, café/alleys and permanent props
inheritedSettings.animal_behavior: Nose, mouth and realistic paws only; no human hands
inheritedSettings.rights: No automatic external paid voice generation or publication

steps.action: Parse one user prompt into premise, exact scene beats, narration, characters, emotional payoff, story constraints
Emit stable shot IDs, locations, actor positions/poses, physical contacts, visual info, camera, transitions, narration/sfx cues
Validate physical prop sizes, fixed café/town geometry, support heights and unobstructed 9:16 camera paths
Compile scenes only from the Episode01 reference asset registry with story-specific props/poses
Verify Episode01 source SHA, exact grade/ink/lens, TypeScript, continuity, animal behavior and original character identity
Render real selected frames and low-cost video segments for every action/contact/reveal
Vision-capable local agent watches footage, compares to exact Episode01 video, fixes failed shots and rerenders them until accepted
steps.require: Locally connected renderer + true video-inspection loop (NOT currently present)

steps.action: Use approved voice/cleared original or licensed music and SFX, synchronize to narration
steps.require: Explicit approval before any paid API or unlicensed media

steps.action: Render full 1080x1920 H264/AAC master and run encoded-file release_quality_gate.py with expected frame count
Human verifies actual final MP4, rights and emotional quality; no autopublish

completionRule: Do not call an episode on-brand or finished unless the actual encoded movie is creatively and technically reviewed against the approved Episode 01 reference.
neverClaim: That copying Episode 1 asset code alone certifies Episode 1 visual quality.
